prompt: Some people think that universities should provide graduates with the knowledge and skills needed in the workplace. Others think that the true function of a university should be to give access to knowledge for its own sake. Discuss both views.
essay: Universities have important role in education. Some people believe universities should teach practical skills for jobs. Other people think universities should focus on academic knowledge. Both views have good points. First, if universities teach job skills, students can find work easily after graduation. For example, engineering students learn how to design buildings. This is useful in workplace. Companies want graduates who can work immediately. Second, universities should also teach general knowledge. Students need to learn subjects like history and philosophy. This helps them understand the world better. It makes them better citizens. In my opinion, universities should do both things. They should teach practical skills and also academic subjects. This way students get complete education.

prompt: In some countries, governments are encouraging industries and businesses to move out of large cities and into regional areas. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay: Nowadays, many governments are trying to move companies from big cities to countryside. This trend has both positive and negative effects. On the one hand, moving businesses to regional areas can reduce problems in cities. Cities are very crowded with too many people and cars. If companies move to countryside, there will be less traffic and pollution in cities. Also, countryside areas will develop more. People in villages can find jobs near their homes. This is good for rural economy. On the other hand, this policy has some disadvantages. First, countryside areas may not have good infrastructure like roads and internet. Companies need these facilities to work efficiently. Second, many employees may not want to leave cities because cities have better schools and hospitals for their families. In conclusion, I think the advantages are greater than disadvantages. However, governments should improve infrastructure in regional areas before moving companies there.
